utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hello there! Were we supposed to talk about that repair drive thingy today?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hi. Yeah, I think we were supposed to meet about it. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I don't quite remember either... did I have a list somewhere?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I've been so busy lately—what's that again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center! We're fixing up old appliances and electronics for folks who can't afford repairs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, that sounds great! I've got an old toaster that's been acting up—can I bring that along?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you planning to bring your own tools to the repair drive, or should I bring extra?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got my own set, but thanks for offering.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, see you there at 10 then?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, did you hear about the repair drive? We're rounding up volunteers to fix up old Mr. Henderson's fence this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I heard about that! I can help—what time and where exactly should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, we're meeting at Mr. Henderson's place at 9 AM. Can you bring some extra nails if you've got 'em?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Hana, I heard about the repair drive. Let me know if you need any tools or a hand loading things up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam. What exactly do we need for the repair drive? I want to make sure we have everything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We'll need sturdy boxes for sorting items, some basic tools like screwdrivers and pliers, and maybe a few old blankets to wrap fragile things.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning, Mara. The repair drive starts at 9. Got my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Morning, Leo! I've got my toolbox packed too—let's make sure we get that old fence on Elm Street fixed up first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. See you at Elm Street at 9.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I'm so glad you stopped by—I wanted to chat about the neighborhood repair drive we're planning for next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, repair drive? Saturday? Yeah, sounds good, just let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Bring any small appliances or furniture that need fixing, and if you have a toolbox, that'd be a big help too!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we checked if the repair drive has enough space for all the backups?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't looked into that yet, but we should definitely make a list of what we're backing up to estimate the size.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good idea. Let's start listing everything we need, and I'll check the drive's available space in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I hear the repair drive is really picking up steam — folks have been dropping off old toasters and radios all morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great to hear! I've got a broken lamp I've been meaning to bring by, just wasn't sure if they'd take it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I bet they'd take it — Bob was saying they're fixing anything with a cord. Just drop it off at his garage anytime.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I heard we're gathering supplies for the repair drive. Do we need me to check my stash of spare parts?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure about that? I haven't heard anything official yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I must've gotten ahead of myself—Sam mentioned it in passing, but maybe I misheard. I'll hold off on digging through my garage for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, need a hand—or a toolbox? I've got just about everything in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus! I might take you up on that. What’s the first thing we should tackle?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, let's start with that wobbly porch step—I've got a level and some shims in the truck that'll sort it out quick.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Tess, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, definitely! I've been telling everyone about it, and I heard the Smiths are bringing their old lawnmower. Should be fun!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that's perfect! Do we have enough people signed up to help with the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, do you think the repair drive on Saturday will wrap up before the school pickup? I've got to be at the gate by 3.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh absolutely, I think we'll be done by noon at the latest! Marcus is great at keeping things moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that's a huge relief. I'll still bring snacks just in case we run a little long.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Well, I'm not entirely sure yet—I wanted to check with you first before jumping in. What have you heard about it so far?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not much, honestly. Just that people are gathering tools and supplies at the community center. You thinking of joining?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that repair drive will actually fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, honey, I heard from Jerry down the street that it patched up his leaky pipes good as new—but you know Jerry, he’ll believe anything!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Jerry? The guy who thought his car could fly after watching too many sci-fi movies?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo! I'm so glad you're here. Are you thinking of joining the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, absolutely! I've been gathering spare parts and tools in my garage for months—it's about time they got some use.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Cleo! Your spare parts will be a huge help—I know a few folks who could really use them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I heard about it. I might help a bit, if I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, can you meet at my garage Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning sounds fine. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Oren, I heard something about a repair drive from Mrs. Gable—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about that... or was it a bake sale? Let me check my pockets.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, sorry if I got it mixed up—maybe it was a bake sale? Do you have any details on that flyer?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. What's the deal?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it's some kind of tool for fixing things around here, but honestly, I've been so busy lately I haven't paid much attention.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Same here, my to-do list is a mile long. So, anyone actually used it yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam! Are you ready for the repair drive this weekend? I've got some tools set aside.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'm looking forward to it! Let me know if you need any extra hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Sam! I think we'll have a good turnout. Let's meet at the community center at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Gus! Are you coming to the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet I'll be there—I've already loaded my truck with extra drills and socket sets for anyone who needs 'em.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Gus! I'll make sure to point folks your way if they need any tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I'm late. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is happening this Saturday at the community center, starting at 9 AM. I heard they're fixing broken household items for free.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh sweet, I've got a busted toaster—think they’d take a look at it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—need any help picking up supplies from the hardware store?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that'd be great, actually. I could use a hand with the lumber and screws—got a list right here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, hand me the list and I'll grab those for you.
